description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
